MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE
25004293
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO. F01239523
CAMBRIDGE CROSSING HOMEOWNER'S ASSOCIATION, INC., is the
Plaintiff, and SHARON STATON, ET
ALS., are Defendants, writ of execution for the sale of mortgaged
premises dated 10/14/2025.
By virtue of the above stated Writ,
to me directed and delivered, I will
expose to sale at public vendue on
WEDNESDAY, the 25TH DAY of
FEBRUARY A.D. 2026, at the hour of
one thirty o' clock by the then
prevailing (Standard or Daylight
Saving) time, in the afternoon of
the said day, at the Heldrich Hotel,
10 Livingston Ave, New Brunswick,
N.J. 08901.
The property to be sold constitutes
the tract described below and as
more particularly described in the writ of execution filed with the
Sheriff of Middlesex County
pursuant to which this sale is being
held.
Being in the TOWNSHIP OF SOUTH
BRUNSWICK, Monmouth Junction,
County of Middlesex and State of
New Jersey being more particularly
described as follows, to wit:
Being commonly known as: 202
MANNING COURT, MONMOUTH
JUNCTION, NJ 08852 Township of
South Brunswick.
Being Lot 4.52, Block 84 as shown
on the Official Tax Map of South
Brunswick, said Unit being more
specifically described in the Master
Deed, recorded on January 22,
2016 in the Office of the Clerk of
Middlesex in Deed Book 06779,
Page 0368, et seq., as amended
from time to time.
Current upset figure as of 12/17/25
is $43,297.86.
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale
and satisfaction of the mortgage
debt, including costs and expenses,
there remains any surplus money,
the money will be deposited into
the Superior Court Trust Fund and
any person claiming the surplus, or
any part thereof, may file. a motion
pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and
4:57-2 stating the nature and
extent of that person's claim and
asking for an order directing
payment of the surplus money. The
Sheriff or other person conducting
the sale will have information
regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the
upset to be satisfied by said sale is
the sum of TWENTY SIX THOUSAND
FORIY FIVE DOLLARS AND SEVENTEEN CENTS ($26,045.17) dollars
more or less, plus interest together
with the costs of this sale. THE
UPSET AMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT
TO FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS. The subscriber reserves the right to
adjourn said sale from time to time
subject only to such limitations or
restrictions upon the exercise of
such power as may be specially
provided by law or rules of the
Court. Sold subject to conditions of
sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of
bid in certified check or official
bank check at close of sale and the
balance in two weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff
Ansell Grimm & Aaron, PC
100 Canal Pointe Blvd Suite 206
Princeton, NJ 08540
Attorneys
